visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit studio environment. A woman with her black hair pulled back in a neat bun and wearing a black one-shoulder top with a choker-style cutout stands centered. She gestures expressively with her hands as she speaks to the camera. The background is a clean, organized room with shelving holding various lifestyle items. (2) A fast-paced montage follows. The woman is shown in a variety of travel settings: a bustling European train station with baggage, lounging on the deck of a yacht under a clear blue sky, walking down a sunny street wearing a red Ferrari cap, and finally posing by a canal in Venice at dusk with gondolas and a stone bridge visible behind her. (3) Returning to the studio, she presents a YSL foundation bottle, holding it up for a clear view of the label. She points at the product and then demonstrates its texture. A close-up shows the light-colored liquid foundation being applied to the back of a hand and spread with a finger to show its smooth consistency. (4) She applies the foundation to her face using a black makeup sponge. A vertical split-screen effect compares the 'Before' side of her face to the 'After' side, highlighting the coverage of skin tone unevenness. She tilts her head and touches her skin, showing off a dewy, luminous finish. (5) She introduces a black quilted YSL powder compact. She demonstrates the application technique by dabbing a black puff onto her forehead and cheeks. Another montage shows her skin's appearance at different times of the day—AM 10:30, PM 14:20, and PM 21:00—in different lighting conditions including indoor malls and restaurants. (6) In the final segment, she performs a transfer test by pressing a clean white tissue against her cheek. She shows the tissue to the camera, revealing no makeup transfer. She concludes by holding up the foundation bottle again, gesturing with three fingers to list promotion points against the studio background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main character in studio and travel clips, 1 female friend lying on a boat in the background of one travel clip.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with black hair often tied back. She wears a black one-shoulder top in the studio and various travel outfits including a black tank top, a red Ferrari cap, and a striped dress.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between a clean indoor studio with shelves, a busy European train station interior, the white deck of a motor yacht on blue water, sunny urban streets in Italy, the historic canals and bridges of Venice at dusk, and various dimly lit interiors like restaurants and restrooms for the wear test.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio features a high-fidelity female Mandarin voiceover characterized by an enthusiastic and friendly tone. A bright, mid-tempo acoustic-pop background track accompanies the speech throughout the entire video. The music features a rhythmic guitar strumming and a steady, light drum beat at approximately 110 BPM. The voice is clear, with expressive pitch modulation suggesting high positive valence. (2) As the narrator discusses product application, the vocal delivery becomes more instructional. The music maintains a constant energy, serving as a cohesive bed for the fast-paced editing. Very faint incidental mechanical clicks are heard during product handling, but they do not distract from the primary speech signal. (3) During the travel montage segments, the audio remains dominated by the studio-recorded voiceover and BGM, with no discernible field noise from the outdoor scenes. The speech rate is brisk, reflecting the information-dense nature of the review. (4) The final section concludes with a persuasive pitch. The narrator’s volume increases slightly for emphasis on promotional discounts. The music continues at its established volume until the end of the clip, where it fades out along with the final words of the narrator.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience Demo -> Product Features -> Instructional Demo -> Long-term Performance Test -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the YSL All Hours Foundation by demonstrating its durability and radiant finish during a real-world travel scenario in Italy, followed by a technical application guide and promotional offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of YSL products, mention of product names in subtitles, and detailed promotional pricing for an anniversary event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines lifestyle travel content with a structured beauty product review. The fast editing pace and dewy visual aesthetic target a young, travel-oriented demographic interested in high-end cosmetic brands.
